🎉🐾 TOP DOG IS 10 TODAY! 🐾🎉

10 years of happy paws, wagging tails and wonderful memories! 💚

Today marks a very special milestone for Top Dog as we celebrate our 10th anniversary!

But the story really began long before we opened our doors on 29 October 2016...

Laura's love of dogs started long before Top Dog. As a child, she would happily walk and groom her neighbours' dogs for free, simply because she loved spending time with them. She even organised a big dog agility show featuring some of the neighbourhood dogs! Looking back, perhaps the signs of her future career were there all along. 🐾 🐶

Fast forward a few years, and Laura's childhood love of dogs had grown into a dream of working with them every day. It was a dream her husband Stuart came to share, and together we decided to take a leap of faith, leaving behind our careers in finance (Laura) and construction (Stuart) to turn that dream into reality.

We started with an Open Day, and from there, thanks largely to word of mouth and the wonderful support of our customers, Top Dog has grown into the business it is today.

Over the past decade, we've had the pleasure of welcoming so many wonderful dogs and their owners into our lives. From playful puppies visiting us for the very first time to familiar furry faces who have been part of our Top Dog family for years, it's been an incredible journey.

For us, it's always been about more than grooming, daycare and boarding. It's about building relationships, earning your trust and making sure every dog in our care feels loved, happy and at home.

To all our customers, past and present, thank you for trusting us with your precious four-legged family members and for supporting our small family business over the last decade. Your recommendations, loyalty and friendship have meant the world to us.

We couldn't have reached this milestone without you!

Here's to many more years of happy paws, wagging tails and wonderful memories! 🐶💚

With love and thanks, Laura & Stuart x

#TopDogGuernsey #10YearsOfTopDog #GuernseyDogs #SupportLocalGuernsey

On the day I dropped him off for 11 days I was obviously a little worried but I needn’t have been . Photos and messages showed me he was having the time of his life . It was great to go on holiday knowing that Buddy was in safe and capable hands.
On collecting him he was glowing with health , eyes bright , coat gleaming and happy .
Thank you Laura and Stuart . Buddy will see you both in November for his next holiday . See less

🎉🐾 TOP DOG IS 10 TODAY! 🐾🎉

10 years of happy paws, wagging tails and wonderful memories! 💚

Today marks a very special milestone for Top Dog as we celebrate our 10th anniversary!

But the story really began long before we opened our doors on 29 October 2016...

Laura's love of dogs started long before Top Dog. As a child, she would happily walk and groom her neighbours' dogs for free, simply because she loved spending time with them. She even organised a big dog agility show featuring some of the neighbourhood dogs! Looking back, perhaps the signs of her future career were there all along. 🐾 🐶

Fast forward a few years, and Laura's childhood love of dogs had grown into a dream of working with them every day. It was a dream her husband Stuart came to share, and together we decided to take a leap of faith, leaving behind our careers in finance (Laura) and construction (Stuart) to turn that dream into reality.

We started with an Open Day, and from there, thanks largely to word of mouth and the wonderful support of our customers, Top Dog has grown into the business it is today.

Over the past decade, we've had the pleasure of welcoming so many wonderful dogs and their owners into our lives. From playful puppies visiting us for the very first time to familiar furry faces who have been part of our Top Dog family for years, it's been an incredible journey.

For us, it's always been about more than grooming, daycare and boarding. It's about building relationships, earning your trust and making sure every dog in our care feels loved, happy and at home.

To all our customers, past and present, thank you for trusting us with your precious four-legged family members and for supporting our small family business over the last decade. Your recommendations, loyalty and friendship have meant the world to us.

We couldn't have reached this milestone without you!

Here's to many more years of happy paws, wagging tails and wonderful memories! 🐶💚

With love and thanks, Laura & Stuart x

Happy Top Dogs, Happy Owners!
Meet the gorgeous Lola!
Lola has been coming to Top Dog for day care and grooming since she was young, and it's safe to say Laura and Stuart have become her second family!
Here's what her owner, Sarah Friend, has to say:
 "Taking Lola here from a young age has been the best decision. I always get compliments on how well she is with other dogs, big, small or nervous, and I think that's down to the socialisation she got here.
Laura and Stuart are always flexible and happy to help where they can. I know when I leave Lola here she is in great hands and I wouldn't trust anyone more."
Thank you, Sarah, for such lovely feedback and for trusting Top Dog with Lola!

HERE'S TO MANY MORE HAPPY PAWS!
Just look at all these gorgeous faces!
 And these are just some of the wonderful dogs we've had the pleasure of looking after over the years!
Swipe through to see more of our Top Dog family, from fun-filled days in our care to looking fabulous after a visit to our grooming salon!
As our 10th anniversary celebrations come to a close, we're looking back on a decade of wagging tails, happy paws, cheeky characters and so many wonderful memories!
Every dog who has come through our doors has their own personality and a special place in our hearts, and we feel incredibly lucky to have been part of their lives.
To all our lovely customers, past and present, thank you for trusting us with your precious four-legged family members. Your support, loyalty and friendship have meant the world to us, and we wouldn't be celebrating this milestone without you.
 Now it's your turn to show off your Top Dogs!
We've shared lots of fun photos of the dogs in our care, but we'd love to see some of your furry friends looking their very best after a visit to our grooming salon!
Have you got a photo of your dog looking freshly groomed and fabulous? Share it in the Facebook comments or tag us in your Instagram photos. We'd love to see those gorgeous faces and celebrate even more of our Top Dog family!
Here's to 10 years of happy paws, wonderful friendships and doing what we love – with plenty more to come!
Love, Laura & Stuart

10 YEARS OF HAPPY PAWS – MAPLE'S FAMILY SAY...
Just look at that happy face!
 Gorgeous Maple certainly knows how to enjoy herself, and we love having her as part of our Top Dog family!
As our 10th anniversary celebrations continue, we're sharing another lovely testimonial, this time from Maple's owner, Katrina, who first brought her to us for a puppy groom when she was just three months old!
 "I first met Laura & Stuart when I took my dog Maple for her first puppy groom when she was only 3 months old and she’s now 3 years old! Laura & Stuart are like extended family, it is so wonderful to have someone that you can trust 100% to take care of your dog whilst you’re at work or on holiday, and they are fantastic groomers too! Maple absolutely adores going to Top Dog, I think she prefers it to her own home! Thank you Laura & Stuart for everything you do, your support is invaluable."
– Katrina, Maple's owner
From her very first puppy groom to all the fun she's had with us since, it's been such a pleasure watching Maple grow up!
Thank you, Katrina, for your wonderful words and for trusting us with your gorgeous girl over the years. It's lovely to know we're considered part of the family!
Love, Laura & Stuart
